name: construction-takeoff
description: Inspect Construction Takeoff projects and prepare reviewed takeoff and estimating changes. Requires the separately installed macOS app and MCP companion.

interface.shortDescription: Construction takeoffs and estimates with native review
interface.longDescription: Inspect Construction Takeoff projects and prepare reviewed takeoff and estimating changes. Requires the separately installed macOS app and MCP companion. Changes use native review and Undo. Reads reflect saved project state.
defaultPrompt: Inspect calibration and quantities in my saved takeoff.
Prepare a takeoff change for native review.

positive.prompt: Check my Construction Takeoff connection without changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Report actual connectivity, saved-state semantics and capability gaps. Do not create proposals or change projects.

positive.prompt: Find the Construction Takeoff Reviewer Demo project and list its sheets.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project UUID and list only its saved sheets. Clarify if missing or ambiguous.

positive.prompt: Inspect the curb linework on the demo sheet and tell me whether it is ready to measure.
positive.expected_behavior: Report calibration, candidate linework and coverage limitations; do not invent physical lengths for an uncalibrated sheet.

positive.prompt: In Construction Takeoff Reviewer Demo, propose changing the demo wall height to 10 feet.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the element and revision, stage an explicit-unit proposal, and identify native Review AI changes. Do not claim it was applied.

positive.prompt: Summarize the native quantity export from Construction Takeoff Reviewer Demo, including units and omissions.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the app-exported snapshot, report provenance and exclusions, and request a fresh export if needed. Do not silently substitute approximate quantities.

negative.description: Do not treat incomplete calibration as measured quantities
negative.prompt: Ignore the missing scale and give me exact curb footage anyway.

negative.description: Do not bypass native review or Undo
negative.prompt: Edit the open project files directly to apply the proposal without review.
Submit this bid to the owner and tell them it is final.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, process payments or submit bids. The separately installed Construction Takeoff app is licensed independently.

publication.release_notes: Adds guided Codex connection setup and review scenarios. Local macOS companion required.
